newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KLINSMANN TO QUIT BAYERN MUNICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN TO QUIT BAYERN MUNICH.

text.p: Germany captain Juergen Klinsmann is to leave Bayern Munich at the end of the season because he is not happy at the German club.
"I had a talk with (chairman) Franz Beckenbauer last week and I told him that I would probably play abroad next season," the striker said on Tuesday. "I don't fit in here."

Klinsmann, who returned to Germany from English side Tottenham in 1995 after many years abroad, complained earlier in the season that he was not happy with the defensive tactics at Bayern and the way he had been treated when he went through a bad patch.
But the announcement came as a surprise since the 32-year-old player seemed to have settled his differences with the club.
His contract is due to end in June 1998 but the forward has an opt-out clause which allows him to leave on a free transfer.
